description: Tells whether a rent or sale price is below, in line with or above the market: per m² against the same residence, station or district, same bedrooms first. Give a listing id, or a price with size or bedrooms and a place. Gives the median and the typical range.

condo.description: Residence (condo building) name, e.g. "Life Asoke", "Noble Ploenchit", "The Lofts Asoke".

id.description: An active listing's id, from search_condos or nearby_condos: its own price, size and place are checked. Or give price and a place instead.

lang.description: Language of the titles and links: en, fr, th, ja (Japanese) or zh (simplified Chinese). Use the user's language.

price.description: The price to check, in THB: per month for rent, total for sale.

size_sqm.description: Living area in m²: gives a comparison per m², the closest one.

station.description: BTS/MRT station name or code, e.g. "Asok", "Phrom Phong", "BTS-CEN".

name: price_check
title: Is this price fair?
